name: Suicide Friend
original_name: スーサイド・フレンド
source:
Shinozaki Saya's mother had been depressed and committed suicide a few years back.
His classmate, Tsuyuki Hotaru, had been rumored to be cutting himself.
That reminded Saya of his mother and so, he took interest in Hotaru.

After he asked Hotaru to become his friend, their odd relationship started.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ324312.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
筱崎沙耶的母亲几年前因抑郁而自杀。
有传言称，他的同学Tsuyuki Hotaru割伤了自己。
这让沙耶想起了他的母亲，因此他对萤产生了兴趣。

在他邀请萤成为他的朋友后，他们奇怪的关系开始了。
